caseName: Ayers v. Thompson, United States Congressman
caseNameFull: Ayers v. Thompson, United States Congressman, Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to file an amended petition for writ of certiorari granted. Motions of Ivory Phillips, Chairman of Mississippi Coalition for Higher Education, et al., and Alcorn State University National Alumni et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.
